title: Yellowed Velvety British Lamb Sunday Roast
description: A savory and velvety British dish featuring lamb, kinako, and tandoor spices, perfect for a special Sunday roast, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220 degrees Celsius.
In a small bowl, mix together kinako, tandoor spice mix, turmeric, and ginger.
Rub the spice mixture all over the lamb shoulder, making sure to coat it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe pot over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, then remove it from the pot.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for an additional minute.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot and add enough water to cover the bottom of the pot.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the lamb for 2.5 hours, or until it is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove the pot from the oven and let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
